description: This file contains integration test cases for loan creation, approval, disbursement, repayments, and related actions in the Apache Fineract project, utilizing Feign clients and JUnit assertions.

classes.name: FeignLoanCreationTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing loan creation, approval, disbursal, and repayment functionalities via Feign client in Apache Fineract.

methods.name: testCreateAndDisburseLoan_OnePeriodNoInterest
methods.description: Tests creating and disbursing a simple loan with a single period and no interest.

methods.name: testLoanRepayment_FullRepayment
methods.description: Tests full repayment of a loan.

methods.name: testLoanUndoApproval
methods.description: Tests undoing a loan approval to revert loan status to pending approval.

methods.name: testLoanUndoDisbursement
methods.description: Tests undoing a loan disbursement to revert loan status to waiting for disbursal.

methods.name: testFourInstallmentLoan_CumulativeInterest
methods.description: Tests a loan with four installments and cumulative interest, verifying the repayment schedule.

methods.name: testPartialRepayment
methods.description: Tests partial repayment of a loan and verifies remaining outstanding amount.

methods.name: testUndoRepayment
methods.description: Tests undoing a repayment to revert the loan's state and repayment schedule.
